sin.name: inertia-bypass
sin.description: A frontend file reaches the server around Inertia: it imports the JSON request client (jsonRequests) or axios, so its request carries no Inertia headers, its answer is no page and its errors never reach the page's props.
sin.rule: Never bypass Inertia (user message 13525): read through the page's props and a partial router.reload({ only: [...] }), and change through router.post/put/delete to the page's own action routes, which answer with only the props they change. The terminal's control stream is the one machine client of the JSON routes.
